paragraphs.text: The Obsidian Well was a city of dragons carved out of the inside of a mountain somewhere in Dominaria during the reign of the Primevals .

It was a huge cavern with an open exit for dragons at the top. The dragons kept many slaves which they would torment using flexible metal rings strapped around their bellies. One of these slaves was Rokin from Mitrokin village. When the Primevals fell in c. -17,000 AR , the slaves revolted and killed the dragon leaders. It is unknown what happened to the Obsidian Well after that, where specifically it was located, or if it still exists in some form more than 21,500 years later.
